purpose: Test the most direct second-moment linearization of the structured GF(3) quadratic C4 carrier. Give an explicit 8-vertex 4-regular Hamiltonian non-3-colourable graph whose lifted affine linear system in a symmetric moment matrix X is feasible after rank-one consistency is dropped. This isolates rank-one/product consistency as essential global information.

graph_control.degree_fact: Every vertex has degree four; deleting the Hamiltonian cycle leaves exactly the two displayed C4 components.
graph_control.unsat_fact: The exact checker exhausts all 3^8 vertex colourings and finds no proper 3-colouring. Hence the v5.5 quadratic system has no rank-one solution.

moment_lift.rankone_definition: For t in GF(3)^8 put z=(1,t_0,...,t_7) and X=z z^T. Then X is symmetric rank one, X_00=1, X_ii=t_i^2=1 for nowhere-zero Hamiltonian tensions, X_0i=t_i, the Hamiltonian closure is sum_i X_0i=0, and every C4 sphere equation is a linear trace equation in the t-t block of X.
moment_lift.relaxation: Keep symmetry and all these affine linear equations but drop rank(X)=1 and the bilinear identities X_ij=X_0i X_0j.

verification.diagonal: All nine diagonal entries including X_00 are one.
verification.cycle_closure: The first-row tension entries X_0i are all zero, so their sum is zero.
verification.C4_equations: Using the exact v5.4 interval/projective forms for C4=(0,3,1,6) and C4=(2,4,7,5), the checker evaluates each linearized quadratic form at X to 1 in GF(3).
verification.conclusion: The lifted linear system accepts this UNSAT/non-3-colourable instance although no rank-one feasible matrix exists.

theorem.name: SOURCE_ALIGNED_SECOND_MOMENT_LINEARIZATION_NEEDS_RANKONE_ENFORCEMENT
theorem.statement: For the v5.5 C4-only Hamiltonian GF(3) carrier, affine feasibility of the symmetric second-moment equations is not equivalent to 3-colourability. Rank-one/product consistency cannot be dropped.
theorem.scope: This is a finite exact barrier to the plain degree-2 moment relaxation. It is not a lower bound against stronger polynomial rank-reduction, higher-order moment, determinant, or combinatorial methods.

killed: Solve the v5.5 structured MQ system by introducing all pair moments X_ij and running only GF(3) Gaussian elimination.
Claim that interval/C4 coefficient structure forces every feasible moment matrix to rank one.
Use second-moment affine feasibility as SAT/3-COLOR evidence.
not_killed: A polynomial theorem that adds selected rank constraints/cuts and provably drives X to rank one.
A determinant/Pfaffian representation encoding rank-one consistency implicitly.
A combinatorial augmentation on the projective ONE_NONZERO_3 blocks.

next_target.name: E8_C4_PROJECTIVE_RANKONE_CUT_OR_AUGMENTATION_V5_7
next_target.directive: Do not use the naked second-moment relaxation. Identify a polynomial family of exact rank-one consequences tailored to Hamiltonian interval/C4 structure, or switch back to the projective ONE_NONZERO_3 view and seek a global augmentation theorem. Every candidate must reject the explicit 8-vertex false positive before promotion.
